newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
SOUTH KOREA, Sept 9 - Berth congestion/berthing delay at Korean ports, Busan - 147 Vessels in port, 62 at berth and 85 at anchorage, berthing delay usually two to three days.
Ulsan - 130 Vessels in port, 80 at berth and 50 at anchorage, berthing delay usually one to two days.
Pohang - 35 Vessels in port, 31 at berth and four at anchorage, no delay.
Inchon - 95 vessels in port, 52 at berth and 43 at anchorage, berthing delay usually two to three days.
MOROCCO, Casablanca, Sept 7 Safi - Delay for sulphur vessels two days and for phosphate vessels one day.
